name: Kali Linux 2026.3 KDE Desktop in Your Browser
description: Kali Linux 2026.3 KDE desktop with the default tool set, in a browser tab.

PASSWORD.description: Browser login password, generated at deploy (copy it from this variable). Min 8 chars, 12+ recommended. The desktop does not start without it.

CUSTOM_USER.description: Browser login name (letters, digits, . _ @ -). The Linux account inside the desktop is 'abc', with passwordless sudo.

PORT.description: Port of the desktop's web server (nginx). The public domain and the healthcheck use it. 3001 and 8082 are used internally.

TZ.description: Time zone of the desktop clock and apps, e.g. Europe/Istanbul.

TITLE.description: Browser tab title of the desktop page.

APT_PACKAGES.description: Optional. Distribution packages (space-separated) reinstalled in the background after every redeploy, e.g. 'seclists gobuster'.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between stop signal and kill on redeploy, so desktop apps and services shut down cleanly.
